title: atlas-item: the atlas hooks of a STAC Item
description: The atlas: fields a STAC Item carries for the atlas app: which cell of the collection's cube the item is (atlas:dims, required), its observed value range, whether it is empty by construction, and on its assets the draw hints (band, rescale, colormap) and the join keys of a values table. Read by atlas/src/lib/catalog/*.ts; written by the atlas pipeline and workflows/R/eov_share.R. STAC core is out of scope: only type, stac_version, id and the profile's own fields are constrained, and other keys pass through.

properties.description: the item properties; atlas:dims is required

atlas:dims.description: one value per cube dimension: which cell of the collection's cube this item is (e.g. {eov: fish, metric: share})

atlas:value_range.description: the observed [min, max] of the item's values: the legend and the colour domain

atlas:absent.description: true for an item with no data by construction: drawn as an empty slot, never as zero

atlas:absent_note.description: the text beside the empty slot of an absent item

atlas:metric.description: the kind of value (richness, uncertainty ...) where sdm:response_type is mixed

assets.description: the assets, with the atlas draw hints and join keys

atlas:bidx.description: the 1-based band of a multi-band COG to draw; absent = band 1

atlas:rescale.description: the display range [min, max], or auto (read from the band statistics)

atlas:colormap.description: a named colormap (viridis, spectral_r ...); absent = the default ramp

atlas:value_column.description: the column of a wide values table holding this item's values

atlas:key_column.description: the join key column of a values table (FID, h3); absent = FID

atlas:id_field.description: the feature id property of a PMTiles grid; absent = FID

sdm:h3_resolution.description: the H3 resolution of an H3-keyed asset
